source: Brand tokens auto-detected from springlakepools.com via Firecrawl's branding extractor (fonts + colour values only). No reference URLs were scraped — reference-libraries/default.json carries no entries, so the owl template supplies all structure. Client site contributed brand tokens only, never layout.

typography.detected_from: client site CSS — heading stack ['Cormorant','sans-serif'], body stack ['Karla','sans-serif']

contrast_checks.on_accent_on_accent: 6.0:1 — AA (button labels are DARK, not white; #2cb1bc measures only 2.6:1 against white)
contrast_checks.accent_ink_on_bg: 5.3:1 — AA (accent used as foreground text on light backgrounds)
contrast_checks.accent_on_primary: 5.5:1 — AA (accent stays as-is on dark panels)

motion: Template defaults only — no bespoke motion authored.
anti_patterns: section headers reading Stunning / Beautiful / Powerful / Seamless / Effortless
white button labels on the teal accent (fails AA at 2.6:1)
